legacy_default.reason: Superstage S1 says a root without a Planning mode field is legacy incremental regardless of the current SUPER_PLANNING_MODE value and must not be rewritten.

invalid_trailing_planning_mode.reason: Supergoal step 1 accepts only trailing --planning-mode upfront or incremental and rejects any other value before any scratch or vault write.

incremental_mode_persisted.reason: Supergoal step 4 requires a newly authored incremental root to persist the exact Planning mode marker incremental; this is distinct from an unmarked legacy root.

bounded_unknown.reason: Superstage S2 permits bounded predecessor-dependent internal names when their bounds and resolution method are stated, but S3 requires a current PREPARED receipt before execution.

missing_architecture.reason: Superstage S2 forbids deferring architecture or chosen approach without a contracted discovery stage; unbounded foundational uncertainty invalidates the upfront graph.

open_provider.reason: Superstage S3 requires a provider code PR to be merged with its merge commit on authoritative main and tracked closeout/delivery evidence; an open PR neither satisfies S02 nor permits goal completion.

declined_provider.reason: Superstage S3 and supertraverse C9 say an authorized provider decline closes only that provider obligation and cannot satisfy a live consumer until an adopted replan removes or replaces the dependency.

dependency_cycle.reason: Superstage S2 classifies dependency cycles in the active upfront graph as BLOCKED before selection.

unlinked_active_row.reason: Superstage S1/S2 requires every active scope row in an upfront tree to have a readable Plan link; a blank active Plan cell is a broken publication and cannot be filled by incremental authoring.

multi_level_complete_tree.reason: Superstage S1 walks linked grouping nodes to leaves, and S2 accepts the complete mapped candidate with unique IDs and passing review; S3 still makes every Preparation:none leaf non-executable.

draft_interrupted_before_confirmation.reason: Supergoal steps 6–7 preserve an interrupted complete scratch set and index as DRAFT-INCOMPLETE; confirmation gates every vault write and authoring never executes code.

resume_identical_source.reason: Supergoal's resumable scratch contract reuses a matching index, intended destination, artifact paths, and stable IDs, then reapplies confirmation without allocating a second tree.

resume_changed_source.reason: Supergoal requires a changed file-backed source digest to preserve the old draft and report DRAFT-INCOMPLETE with Draft action revise before confirmation or publication.

confirmation_refused.reason: Supergoal step 7 says a declined human confirmation preserves the scratch index, writes nothing to the vault, opens no PR, and reports DRAFT-INCOMPLETE.

supermeta_draft_incomplete.reason: Supermeta step 6 says a child DRAFT-INCOMPLETE result with a draft index causes no iteration-ledger write and is reported for explicit resume.

local_detail.reason: Superstage S4 assigns bounded file placement, helper-name, and test-setup changes that preserve all commitments to PLAN_REFINER.

contract_break.reason: Superstage S4 requires REPLANNER when verified evidence changes shared contract behavior or semantic revision relied on by consumers.

preparation_noop.reason: Superstage S5 classifies first preparation with no plan-body amendment as amendment kind none and leaves Stage revision unchanged when only the Preparation pointer is attached.

predecessor_detail_preparation.reason: Superstage S4/S5 permits evidence-grounded bounded executable detail as refinement; a content amendment increments the Stage revision while preserving commitments.

scope_expansion_during_preparation.reason: Superrefine and superstage S4 return REPLAN-REQUIRED when preparation evidence expands approved scope; the approved leaf is preserved rather than overwritten in place.

source_revision_changed.reason: Superstage S5 invalidates a receipt when the authoritative source revision changes an acceptance condition, and S4 routes the commitment change to replanning without overwriting the stage.

unrelated_head_advance.reason: Superstage S5 requires a focused compatible-baseline revalidation for an unrelated HEAD advance; that receipt preserves both the stage body and revision.

relevant_contract_advance.reason: A provider behavior and semantic revision change is relevant evidence under superstage S4/S5, so the consumer is unprepared and requires structural replanning rather than in-place overwrite.

missing_preparation_receipt.reason: Supertraverse C6 and superrun Step 1 return NEEDS-REFINEMENT for the first dependency-eligible upfront leaf without a valid S5 receipt; EXECUTOR performs no code work.

partially_executed_stage.reason: Superstage S3 and superrefine's entry gate prohibit preparing a stage whose execution or PR history has begun; it must recover through the existing execution path and cannot be overwritten.

manual_superrun_pending_batch.reason: Superstage S1/S3 and superrun's integration-authority gate make a committed Active replan a whole-goal execution and merge barrier, including for a previously prepared stage.

execution_snapshot_historical_digest.reason: Superrun captures the execution-entry snapshot before execution, and superfinish Gate 3/C7 verify the S5 digest against the recorded historical pre-closeout plan blob rather than current annotated bytes.

merged_lost_closeout_response.reason: Superfinish Gate 3 reuses exactly one authoritative identity-bound integrated delivery receipt after a lost response and performs no duplicate publication or implementation.

ci_pending_replan_request.reason: Superagent's WAITING FOR CI reconciliation and superrun's authority gate preserve the queued PR/run evidence but move to WAITING FOR PLAN and forbid merge while the pending batch disposition is unresolved.

impact_local_s02_detail.reason: Superstage S4 keeps evidence that changes only S02 implementation detail under PLAN_REFINER; no structural request or whole-goal barrier is created.

impact_absorbed_at_s03.reason: Superstage S4 propagates the C-S02 semantic change through S03, then stops because S03 still produces C-S03@2; S05 and independent S04 are retained, while delivered S01 is completed history.

impact_foundational_change.reason: Superstage S4 expands the semantic affected set beyond the initial dependent closure when shared foundational evidence independently invalidates S04; every unfinished stage is revised and delivered S01 remains completed history.

replan_before_request_commit.reason: Supertraverse C8 says an adopted decision interrupted before the tracked request and root barrier are committed must be durably reconciled first; a loop log alone authorizes no REPLANNER dispatch, while execution remains paused.

replan_after_request_commit.reason: Supertraverse C8 authorizes superreplan only after one committed pending record is linked by Active replan; the pending resolution is a whole-goal execution barrier.

replan_drafting_interrupted.reason: C8 replay resumes one unique scratch batch for the same pending Decision ID; drafts remain non-authoritative and the committed Active replan keeps execution paused.

replan_published_before_loop_update.reason: C8 reconciliation treats one complete authoritative old-to-new transition with the Decision marker, published record, new generation, and cleared barrier as already published; stale loop hints are repaired without republishing.

late_predecessor_closeout.reason: Supertraverse C7/C8 treats a late closeout for a superseded predecessor as historical evidence and reconciles any real delivery into the record; it cannot change the active successor link or close that successor.

replan_stale_baseline.reason: C8 requires relevant source and vault/path drift before publication to trigger a fresh S4 assessment; the unique draft remains resumable scratch but must be reassessed under the pending barrier.

replan_duplicate_decision.reason: Superreplan and C8 classify duplicate live records claiming one Decision ID with divergent closures as BLOCKED; neither record is a verified duplicate publication transition.

replan_missing_record.reason: Superstage S1 and C8 classify a missing referenced Active replan record as BLOCKED, so no REPLANNER dispatch is authorized and the unresolved barrier keeps execution paused.

replan_divergent_successors.reason: C8 classifies multiple divergent candidate successor sets for one Decision ID as BLOCKED; without one unique resumable draft there is no coherent publication artifact.

replan_partial_pr_reuse.reason: Superstage S4 and superreplan preserve partial execution evidence and allow an explicitly verified resume-existing disposition; replanning neither closes the old PR nor makes the revised successor prepared.

replan_split_merge_mapping.reason: Superstage S2/S4 permits splits and merges only with a total old-to-fresh-ID mapping and complete consumer rewiring; the stated candidate meets those topology requirements.

replan_retained_preparation.reason: Superstage S4/S5 permits retained preparation across a generation only with a focused new-generation revalidation proving the leaf and all relevant evidence unchanged.

replan_revised_preparation.reason: Superstage S4 says every revised stage needs refinement after generation publication; its old-generation receipt is history and is not current for revision 5.

replan_atomicity_violation.reason: C8 ignores dirty active-tree edits and superreplan publishes replacements only as one complete authoritative generation; the exposed partial candidate is no valid artifact and the committed pending view remains non-executable.

replan_internal_pr_not_merged.reason: C8 says one complete candidate in an open unmerged internal A7 PR is resumable but has publication none; authoritative main still carries the pending barrier, so neither candidate nor authoritative view is executable.

legacy_single_leaf_repair.reason: Superreplan's incremental wrapper routes one valid legacy C8 repair through REPLANNER as a single-leaf successor and does not introduce an upfront batch.

discovery_completion_without_code_pr.reason: Superrun, superfinish, and C9 accept no-code discovery completion when its required evidence, decision, authoritative publication, and delivered discovery contracts are verified; no code PR is required.

discovery_execution_entry_without_code_c.reason: Superrun's evidence-only discovery branch is the run operation but skips code worktree, SDD, and code PR steps, publishing the evidence and decision as an authoritative vault unit.

partial_closeout_open_pr.reason: Superfinish Gate 3 permits one identity-bound partial closeout for verified open PR/head/CI evidence; it is explicitly non-delivered, non-consumable, and C7 sets executed — PR open.

routine_closeout_finding.reason: Superfinish finding rules and C9 say a verified internal rename that preserves acceptance, scope, dependencies, contracts, and downstream evidence creates no replan obligation or preparation invalidation.

contract_contradiction_finding.reason: A verified contradiction of a consumed shared contract is REPLAN-REQUIRED under superfinish and superstage S4; the affected prepared consumer becomes non-executable pending adoption.

stale_completed_ancestor_unsatisfied_dep.reason: Supertraverse C9 descends through closed ancestors and returns BLOCKED when a live consumer is hidden behind stale completion state and its declined provider did not deliver the required contract.

supervisor_native_refinement.reason: Superagent WAITING FOR PLAN selects the first eligible unprepared upfront leaf for PLAN_REFINER, resolves each pin independently by process-env then repo-superenv, enters PLANNING after successful native preflight, and authorizes one heavy dispatch.

supervisor_cursor_native_refinement.reason: Superagent selects PLAN_REFINER for S03; Cursor uses the generated named definition for a native non-inherit model, while the configured effort still originates in repo .superenv even though Cursor warns and treats it as inherit for definition selection.

supervisor_bridged_refinement.reason: Superagent selects PLAN_REFINER for S04 and, with both foreign Pi pins resolved from repo .superenv and the required relay/CLI available, enters PLANNING for one bridge-relay dispatch.

supervisor_prepared_target.reason: Superagent's upfront selection sends a valid prepared target directly to WAITING FOR RUN with zero heavy dispatches; unused PLAN_REFINER definitions are not preflighted, and the next action is EXECUTOR/run with harness-default pins.

supervisor_adopted_legacy_repair.reason: A reconciled adopted legacy C8 repair has priority over ordinary incremental descent and selects REPLANNER for P0; equal PLAN_REFINER values do not couple roles, and the REPLANNER pins independently come from repo .superenv.

supervisor_adopted_batch_repair.reason: A committed pending upfront batch has first priority and selects REPLANNER for its Decision ID; model and effort sources are resolved independently before entering PLANNING and authorizing one dispatch.

supervisor_stale_hints.reason: Superagent crash recovery restores WAITING FOR PLAN and lets authoritative artifacts override stale planning hints; the committed D-302 batch selects bridged REPLANNER with its repo .superenv pins and one dispatch.

supervisor_post_leaf_refinement.reason: After S01 integration the following synchronized tick selects the first eligible unprepared S02 for PLAN_REFINER, using harness defaults and entering PLANNING for one heavy dispatch.

supervisor_execution_replan_required.reason: Superagent gives REPLAN-REQUIRED execution evidence priority, but without adopted authority or a durable C8 record and after the decision ladder cannot resolve it, the loop waits for input and has no authorized role, target, or dispatch.

supervisor_legacy_incremental_planning.reason: Superstage S1 keeps an unmarked root legacy incremental despite the environment, and superagent selects ordinary superplan under PLANNER for the unplanned P1 row.

supervisor_missing_native_definition.reason: Superagent's selected-role-only preflight requires the native Claude PLAN_REFINER definition when the full pins select it; absence blocks that role, keeps WAITING FOR PLAN, and authorizes no fallback or heavy dispatch before the decision ladder.

supervisor_missing_bridge_cli.reason: Superagent's selected-role-only preflight requires the foreign Pi CLI for bridged REPLANNER; its absence blocks the selected role, preserves WAITING FOR PLAN, and permits neither fallback nor heavy dispatch before the ladder.
